materialIssues: curiosityHook: 'once the cruiser's dangerous owner realizes it is missing' adds both an unsupported characterization of the sheriff as dangerous and a specific causal trigger in which the owner's discovery of the missing cruiser turns the situation lethal; the authorized overview establishes only that the kids enter a deadly cat-and-mouse game after taking the cruiser.
